releaseNotes:
- Fixed: snooze, distance, notification and update texts were showing raw placeholders (like "Snooze {{min}}") instead of real values - they now show e.g. "Snooze 15 min" and "2.3 km away"
- Fixed: all counts (nearby volunteers, SOS recipients, status chips) now display the correct number in English and Urdu
- Fixed: SOS escalation notices now show the widened radius and elapsed time correctly
- Update prompts now always show a complete message even if details are missing
